headline: Unknown projectile causes explosion near oil tanker off the coast of Dubai
label: BREAKING
caption:
An explosion shook waters near the United Arab Emirates after an unknown projectile struck close to a commercial vessel 🚨

According to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency, the blast occurred 50 nautical miles west of Dubai on Thursday.

The tanker master reported the incident, but authorities confirmed that the vessel sustained no damage and there was no environmental impact.

All crew members on board the ship are reported safe and accounted for while investigations continue.
